title: Personalized Basketball Above Hoop and Net Comforter with Name and Number
description:
Bring the excitement of the court into your bedroom with the personalized basketball sports comforter by Jeminise. Featuring a bold basketball design with custom name and number options, this lightweight bedding set is the perfect gift for basketball players, sports fans, and kids' rooms.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize this sports bedding with your own name and player number for a truly unique look.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with a whole-piece microfiber filling that prevents clumping or shifting.
  • Lightweight Warmth: Designed to provide comfortable, lightweight warmth suitable for all seasons.
  • Durable Craftsmanship: Features tight, smooth, and compact stitching along the edges with environmental protection dyeing techniques to prevent fading.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; dries quickly on air dry without heat to regain fluffiness.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Cotton/ Polyester
Selected Design Basketball D14
Pattern Basketball Print
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Closure Type Zipper
